verdict.rationale: IP India runs online e-filing, search and status-tracking services, so an official SDK for programmatic access is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack documents only web portals, downloadable forms and public search pages, with no SDK, client library or developer API. The llms.txt probe returned 404, so no agent-oriented docs index is published either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
